text:
lucy_support: Quick flag from support: CloudFleet reported an April overage. They have a 5-node reserved commit but the bill shows 20 node-hours charged as burst on 04/21. They say they never scaled above 5. Can ops/finance triage? :confused:

marco_fin: Thanks Lucy. Can you paste invoice lines and the reserved pool id? I'll get started on reconciliation.

lucy_support: Ticket CF-4402 with invoice INV-2026-0421. Pool id: cf-reserve-5. Billing snippet from the ticket:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0421
Period: 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30
 - Reserved capacity (cf-reserve-5): 5 nodes - $10,000
 - Burst usage (burst-unallocated): 20 node-hours - $300
Total: $10,300
```

billing-bot: Meter export attached: meter_export_cf_2026_04_21.csv

arun_ops: I pulled the node event stream for 04/21. Root cause looks unusual: during a rolling kernel update, several nodes entered "drain" and were briefly replaced by ephemeral helper nodes that inherited the same pool tag, but our billing joiner had a logic bug and counted both the draining node and the ephemeral replacement simultaneously for a short window -> double counted hours. That double count manifested as burst because the dedupe path marked duplicates as unassigned.

nina_engineering: Confirming Arun's analysis. The dedupe comparator used node_ip + start_ts; during the drain the helper nodes reused IPs from the drained pods for a few minutes, so comparator failed to dedupe. Patch ready to change dedupe key to node_id + activation_ts. Exporting CSV with affected rows: node_id, ts_start, ts_end, seen_tag, meter_id.

kate_sales: CloudFleet is mid-market but on a growth plan. Sales prefers a small goodwill credit on top of the invoice correction because the customer logged increased queuing for 25 minutes.

marco_fin: Need numbers. Nina/Arun, what's the gross overcharge we can correct if we re-associate and dedupe? Also propose a goodwill amount. Finance policy: manager approval up to $2,500; above needs VP.

arun_ops: We computed net effect: 20 node-hours were double-counted but dedupe will remove the duplication; invoice delta $300. Operational impact note: p95 queue latency increased ~220ms for 25 minutes.

nina_engineering: CSV attached (cf_doublecount_04_21.csv). All rows safe for backfill. Backfill job id bf-2026-778 scheduled. Patch deployed to dedupe comparator.

lina_revops: Created revops ticket revops-901; attaching CSV and backfill bf-2026-778. We'll capture audit logs for SOX/AR.

marco_fin: Proposal: invoice adj $300 + goodwill SLA credit $750 = $1,050 total. Manager can approve. Kate, sales signoff?

kate_sales: Approved. We want the message to be concise and own the fix. I'll sync with account exec.

vp_finance: Quick note: $1,050 fine under manager approval but loop me in on the customer email copy.

billing-bot: Generated credit memos: CM-2026-315 (INV adj $300), CM-2026-316 (Service credit $750). Queued for AP posting.

arun_ops: Backfill bf-2026-778 completed. 20 rows de-duplicated and re-associated to cf-reserve-5. No conflicts.

lina_revops: Revops-901 updated with backfill bf-2026-778 and csv cf_doublecount_04_21.csv. Audit trail preserved.

lucy_support: Draft to customer: "We identified a billing duplication during a rolling kernel update that briefly caused helper nodes to be counted alongside draining nodes. We've corrected the meter records (invoice adjustment $300) and applied a $750 service credit to make up for the disruption. We've deployed a fix to our dedupe logic and backfilled the affected rows. Sorry for the inconvenience; credits should reflect within 48h." Sending after AP posts.

marco_fin: AP posted credits to April ledger. Finance closing ticket. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :clap:

lucy_support: Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick fix — appreciate the transparency." :white_check_mark:
